$comment: The expo-updates fingerprints of the binaries currently in users' hands.
An `eas update` only reaches a build whose fingerprint matches exactly;
publishing to any other value reports success and reaches zero devices,
with no error anywhere. scripts/verify-ota-target.mjs compares the working
tree against this file and refuses to publish on a mismatch.
Update this file in the same commit that ships a new binary, and never to
silence the preflight — a mismatch means the update cannot land, not that
"setAside" lists files that landed on main after that binary was built and
only touch another platform's native code. scripts/publish-ota.mjs removes
them from its throwaway tree before fingerprinting that platform, so JS from
main still reaches the binary. Drop the list when that platform ships a new
binary. This file is not a fingerprint input, so editing it never moves one.

android.$note: Built from main 6d435fb1 (EAS build cfd8e7ab, workflow run 35538699951), published to the Play closed alpha 2026-09-21 and promoted to production at full rollout; Play delivered it the same day (the owner's Galaxy S24 Ultra updated 2026-09-21 10:25). channel:insights on 2026-09-23 counted 75 users on 73 and 4 still on 0.1.5 (72) at 7a2df8d1315311cc2c1918693250a2e751da7695 over two days. Android native code is identical between 72 and 73: the iOS-only cache-ownership patch moved the fingerprint because patches/ is hashed whole, so an update from main reaches 72 only if that patch is set aside for it.

ios.$note: Built from main 6d435fb1 (EAS build 5310dd5b, workflow run 35538699951) and uploaded to TestFlight for the internal group Team (Expo) 2026-09-20 21:35 UTC. First binary carrying patches/expo-video+55.0.21+003+ios-cache-ownership.patch alongside the range-cache patch. Submitted to App Review as 0.1.5 on 2026-09-21 after 0.1.5 (53) was pulled out of review and detached, so 53 now backs no submission and no update from main can reach it — the cache-ownership patch is iOS native, so 53 fingerprints differently and cannot be set aside. Until Apple approves this one, the App Store still serves 0.1.4 (52) at c2e22bfa7e480143c37e68b757aa9a91d3bd0c95, so an update published against this fingerprint reaches TestFlight only. channel:insights on 2026-09-23 counted 2 users on 54 and none on 52 over two days.
